summary.text: Mo Wu Tian is a rank four demonic path rising star named among Hu Mei Er's network as heir to an ancient Gu Immortal inheritance.

claims.text: In a cave on San Cha Mountain, after the Ten Tyrants complain that Hu Mei Er used them to test the black and white demons, Tyrant Heng Mei slaps the second brother and scolds them that this is not Nan mountain. He warns them not to find problems with Hu Mei Er and lists Mo Wu Tian among the famous people she is tied to, alongside Lin San Chi and rumors with Li Xian. Narration adds that Mo Wu Tian is even scarier: he inherited a mysterious inheritance of an ancient Gu Immortal and is the number one rising star of the demonic path, and that Lin San Chi, Li Xian, and Mo Wu Tian are all rank four. The nine brothers go pale and speechless.
He is a young man with long black hair that reaches his waist, deep dark purple eyes, and thick eyebrows raised at the ends.

After meeting Fang Yuan, Li Xian thinks that among the younger generation of the demonic path, Mo Wu Tian stands at the top by aptitude, talent, and temperament, then judges little beast king’s talent not inferior. He notes Mo Wu Tian is older and already rank four peak stage, while little beast king’s cultivation is still weaker.

At a San Cha Mountain banquet, Century Boy sighs inwardly that each generation brings new geniuses, naming Mo Wu Tian from a few years ago and Little Beast King now, and that the world is growing tougher even for a godfather.

The land spirit flags a rank five Gu Master mixed into the crowd, and an image shows a young man with waist-length black hair, deep purple eyes, thick raised brows, and an unbridled demonic aura. Fang Yuan names him Mo Wu Tian, a demonic path genius who inherited an ancient inheritance and is a soul path Gu Master, recalling that at Yi Tian mountain Mo Wu Tian beheaded several rank five righteous path Gu Masters and later stormed out of a demonic defeat. Fang Yuan notes that in his previous life Mo Wu Tian did not come to San Cha Mountain. Mo Wu Tian seems to sense the watch, looks toward Fang Yuan’s direction, and charges as the land spirit raises fog for the final Gu refinement.

Alone at the fog edge, his purple eyes clear dog groups through the mist. Hu Mei Er greets him as young master Wu Tian and is shocked that he has advanced to rank five. He says none of the three kings inheritances interest him, then tells her the land spirit is not dead and that a deceased Gu Immortal’s treasure waits in the deepest area behind thick fog and over a hundred thousand dogs. With her network and his cultivation and reputation they gather thousands of demonic Gu Masters. He orders routes of assault while standing guard at the base; Li Xian reads his surge as an amazing ancient inheritance and calls him the demonic path’s number one genius.

After two failed assaults he concludes a human is manipulating an ever-changing dog formation and claims some understanding of enslavement path. When Fiery Star Bao Tong demands an explanation, Mo Wu Tian’s purple eyes shine and he kills the rank four upper stage fire path Gu Master with a single stare. Narration calls that a sight-based killer move that contests souls, and states Mo Wu Tian is a soul path Gu Master with soul strength far above his peers. He lets others split Bao Tong’s Gu, then refuses Hu Mei Er’s urge to organize every demonic Gu Master at once, knowing old experts like Kong Ri Tian and Li Fei Le would not easily obey a young rank five leading for the first time.

After Xiao Mang’s light spear clears fog and shows the iron dog formation, Mo Wu Tian approaches him and proposes that in fifteen minutes they attack from front and back together. Xiao Mang agrees in private. Mo Wu Tian then tells the demonic side he agitated Xiao Mang into a competition and that both sides will attack, while Xiao Mang tells the righteous side he rejected demonic cooperation and will take advantage when the demonic faction draws pressure.

Laughing with purple eyes flashing, he leads in the charge. Narration calls him a soul path Gu Master who had secretly used his Gu to make everyone more fanatical, and while charging he controls Gu to attack dog beasts, influence minds for that atmosphere, and scout for Bai Ning Bing, aiming to kill her so the dog formation falls apart. A dog emperor smash stops him when he finds her hiding place. Tie clan’s four old-timers warn their young master that Mo Wu Tian is a rank five expert not easily fought.

Fang Yuan judges that only two rank five experts are in the blessed land, Xiao Mang and Mo Wu Tian, and that the dog emperors will hold them for some time. In Fang Yuan’s previous life, phantom path Yan Jun shone at Yi Tian mountain until Mo Wu Tian showed up and beat him into retreating.
When Fang Yuan breaks into the open, Mo Wu Tian’s gentle feelings Gu slows him enough for Xiao Mang’s giant light hand to catch up before other events divert both rank five experts.

He arrives alone at the fog edge again and speaks of the immortal treasure to Hu Mei Er. Most demonic Gu Masters have already gone with Chou Jiu, so Mo Wu Tian can gather only a few and must join Chou Jiu’s group. Chou Jiu delays assaults, heals under a life for life rule, and shifts blame until influence drains from Mo Wu Tian to Chou Jiu.

He urges speed toward the bronze hall, argues with Chou Jiu over pace and losses, then screams that they have different opinions and leaves to seize the immortal treasure himself while most demonic Gu Masters stay with Chou Jiu. He and Xiao Mang are later named among those who would soon charge the hall.
When the feat is seen, Mo Wu Tian is in a daze and asks who Fang Yuan is.
Fang Yuan later notes that a stronger soul foundation helps against killer moves like Mo Wu Tian’s purple eyes.

At Yi Tian Mountain, Mo Wu Tian, one of the demonic path’s rising stars, joins the battle and challenges many to one-on-one battles; in the sixth wave he kills three rank four Gu Masters in the chaotic battle and defeats Yan Jun into heavy injuries.
